verdict.rationale: Close ships a built-in AI agent, Chloe, on every plan and usable in workflows. However, the evidence describes Chloe mainly as calling and qualifying leads, booking meetings and updating the CRM, not as producing insights or suggestions from the user's data inside the product. The MCP server only exposes data to external AI tools, so it does not count here. Missing for 10: documented in-product AI insights or analysis of CRM data, AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, detail on what Chloe surfaces to users, independent or hands-on corroboration.
